To support Karibu Tanzania Organsation, a national Non-governmental organisation working as an umbrella organsation for the Folk Development Colleges (FDCs) in Tanzania, with an adminstrative support during limited period until new financing approved, and to develop a comprehensive Strategic Plan 2018-2022.

sector.narrative: Basic life skills for youth and adults

description.narrative: Strengthening collaboration with high level stakeholders, such as the Ministry of Education Science and Technology (MOEST), Tanzania Football Federation (TFF), Institute of Adult Education (IAE) and Tanzania Sports Councils. The ministry has well recognised the contrubution of KTO in the sector by inviting it to relevant high level discussions such as Joint Education Sector Review in 2017 and 2018. Operations support made it possible for KTO to achieve milestones such as establishment of new partner collaboration with other funding partners. Developed collaboration between Linköpings University, KTO and IAE. Development of 2018-2022 Strategic Plan.
